messages.subject: Shading intersecting circles
parts:
Hi all,

Does anyone know how to shade the intersection of two circles? Shading of polygons is done using polygon(), but shading of an object that has no straight lines?


for example:

install.packages("plotrix") ## installs package for circle drawing
require(plotrix)

plot(1:10,1:10,type="n",xlab="",ylab="")
draw.circle(4, 5, 2, border="blue", lwd=1) # circle no. 1
draw.circle(7, 5, 2, border="blue", lwd=1) # circle no. 2

Any suggestions welcome.

Best
Chris
